bool member(string[] words, string word)
    for item := words[]
        if item == word
            return true
    return false

bool has_number(nat[] numbers, nat number)
    for item := numbers[]
        if item == number
            return true
    return false

string[] unique_words(string[] words)
    string[] result := []
    for word := words[]
        if not member(result, word)
            result = result.append(word)
    return result.sorted()

nat find_at(string text, string needle)
    match text.find(needle)
        nat at
            return at
        none
            return #text

string hex_id(int number)
    low := nat(number % 4294967296)
    hex := low.b16
    return "0" * (8 - #hex) + hex

bool glob_match(string text, string pattern)
    previous := array(#text + 1, fill = false)
    previous[0] = true
    for: p < #pattern
        ch := pattern[p]
        next := array(#text + 1, fill = false)
        next[0] = ch == "*" and previous[0]
        for: i < #text
            next[i + 1] = if ch == "*" then previous[i + 1] or next[i] else previous[i] and (ch == "?" or ch == text[i])
        previous = next
    return previous[#text]

class Tree()
    data := map<string, string>()

    bool has(string path)
        return data.has(path)

    string text(string path)
        match data.get(path)
            string value
                return value
            none
                return ""

    void .copy_path(Tree source, string path)
        match source.data.get(path)
            string value
                .data.set(path, value)
            none
                bool removed := .data.remove(path)

    void .put(string path, string value)
        .data.set(path, value)

    void .erase(string path)
        bool removed := .data.remove(path)

string[] all_paths(Tree[] trees)
    string[] result := []
    for item := trees[]
        result = result.concat(item.data.keys())
    return unique_words(result)

bool agree(Tree first, Tree second, string path)
    return first.data.get(path) == second.data.get(path)

string[] differing(Tree first, Tree second)
    return [for path := all_paths([first, second])[] if not agree(first, second, path) then path]

bool equal_trees(Tree first, Tree second)
    return #differing(first, second) == 0

string[] change_list(Tree old, Tree new)
    string[] result := []
    for path := differing(old, new)[]
        result = result.append(if not old.has(path) then "A {path}: {new.text(path)}" else (if not new.has(path) then "D {path}: {old.text(path)}" else "M {path}: {old.text(path)} -> {new.text(path)}"))
    return if #result == 0 then ["(no changes)"] else result

class MergeResult(Tree tree, string[] conflicts)

MergeResult merge_trees(Tree base, Tree ours, Tree theirs)
    merged := Tree()
    string[] conflicts := []
    for path := all_paths([base, ours, theirs])[]
        if agree(theirs, base, path) or agree(ours, theirs, path)
            .merged.copy_path(ours, path)
        elif agree(ours, base, path)
            .merged.copy_path(theirs, path)
        else
            conflicts = conflicts.append(path)
            .merged.copy_path(ours, path)
    return MergeResult(merged, conflicts)

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

void emit_lines(string[] lines)
    for line := lines[]
        emit(line)

nat reference(map<string, nat> refs, string name)
    match refs.get(name)
        nat value
            return value
        none
            return 0

class Commit(string id, nat sequence, nat[] parents, Tree tree, string message)
class StashEntry(string label, nat base, Tree tree)
class Replay(nat original, bool pick, Tree tree)

class Repository()
    Commit[] commit_list := []
    bool[] alive := []
    branches := map<string, nat>()
    tags := map<string, nat>()
    branch := "main"
    nat detached := 0
    work := Tree()
    index := Tree()
    string[] conflicts := []
    op_kind := ""
    nat op_target := 0
    StashEntry[] stash := []
    string[] ignores := []

    nat head()
        return if branch == "" then detached else reference(branches, branch)

    Tree head_tree()
        return commit_list[head()].tree

    Tree parent_tree(nat number)
        return if #commit_list[number].parents == 0 then Tree() else commit_list[commit_list[number].parents[0]].tree

    void .move_head(nat number)
        if branch == ""
            detached = number
        else
            .branches.set(branch, number)

    nat .create(nat[] parents, Tree tree, string message)
        number := #commit_list
        canonical := "commit {number}{NL}"
        for parent := parents[]
            canonical += "parent {commit_list[parent].id}{NL}"
        for path := tree.data.keys().sorted()[]
            canonical += "file {path} {tree.text(path)}{NL}"
        canonical += "message {message}{NL}"
        hash := 0
        for code := canonical.codepoints()[]
            hash = (hash * 131 + code) % 2147483647
        commit_list = commit_list.append(Commit(hex_id(hash), number, parents, tree, message))
        alive = alive.append(true)
        return number

    void .initialize()
        nat root := .create([], Tree(), "init")
        .branches.set("main", root)

    nat | error resolve_rev(string rev)
        parts := rev.split("~")
        anchor := parts[0]
        found := -1
        if anchor == "HEAD"
            found = int(head())
        elif branches.has(anchor)
            found = int(reference(branches, anchor))
        elif tags.has(anchor)
            found = int(reference(tags, anchor))
        else
            for: item := commit_list[i]
                if alive[i] and item.id == anchor
                    found = int(i)
                    break
        if found < 0
            return error("unknown revision '{rev}'")
        number := nat(found)
        nat steps := if #parts == 2 then nat(parts[1]) else 0
        for: i < steps
            if #commit_list[number].parents == 0
                return error("unknown revision '{rev}'")
            number = commit_list[number].parents[0]
        return number

    int[] distances(nat start)
        result := array(#commit_list, fill = -1)
        result[start] = 0
        queue := [start]
        nat at := 0
        while at < #queue
            number := queue[at]
            at += 1
            for parent := commit_list[number].parents[]
                if result[parent] < 0
                    result[parent] = result[number] + 1
                    queue = queue.append(parent)
        return result

    bool ancestor(nat candidate, nat number)
        return distances(number)[candidate] >= 0

    nat merge_base(nat first, nat second)
        int[] a := distances(first)
        int[] b := distances(second)
        excluded := array(#commit_list, fill = false)
        for: item := commit_list[i]
            if a[i] >= 0 and b[i] >= 0
                for parent := item.parents[]
                    excluded[parent] = true
        nat best := 0
        score := -1
        for: i < #commit_list
            if a[i] >= 0 and b[i] >= 0 and not excluded[i]
                candidate := if a[i] > b[i] then a[i] else b[i]
                if score < 0 or candidate < score or (candidate == score and i > best)
                    best = i
                    score = candidate
        return best

    bool[] reachable(nat[] roots)
        result := array(#commit_list, fill = false)
        for root := roots[]
            int[] distance := distances(root)
            for: i < #distance
                if distance[i] >= 0
                    result[i] = true
        return result

    string summary(nat number)
        string[] refs := []
        if head() == number
            refs = refs.append(if branch == "" then "HEAD" else "HEAD -> {branch}")
        for name := branches.keys().sorted()[]
            if reference(branches, name) == number and name != branch
                refs = refs.append(name)
        for name := tags.keys().sorted()[]
            if reference(tags, name) == number
                refs = refs.append("tag: {name}")
        return commit_list[number].id + (if #refs == 0 then "" else " (" + refs.join(", ") + ")") + " " + commit_list[number].message

    bool ignored(string path)
        if index.has(path) or member(conflicts, path)
            return false
        for pattern := ignores[]
            if glob_match(path, pattern)
                return true
        return false

    void | error check_progress()
        if op_kind != ""
            return error("{op_kind} in progress")
        return void

    bool uncommitted()
        if not equal_trees(index, head_tree())
            return true
        for path := index.data.keys()[]
            if not agree(work, index, path)
                return true
        return false

    void | error check_clean()
        if uncommitted()
            return error("uncommitted changes")
        return void

    void | error check_overwrite(string[] paths)
        Tree current := head_tree()
        for path := unique_words(paths)[]
            if not agree(index, current, path) or not agree(work, current, path)
                return error("local changes to '{path}' would be overwritten")
        return void

    void | error .switch_tree(Tree tree)
        selected := differing(head_tree(), tree)
        try check_overwrite(selected)
        for path := selected[]
            .index.copy_path(tree, path)
            .work.copy_path(tree, path)
        return void

    void .record(nat[] parents, Tree tree, string message)
        nat number := .create(parents, tree, message)
        .move_head(number)
        old := commit_list[parents[0]].tree
        nat added := 0
        nat modified := 0
        nat deleted := 0
        for path := all_paths([old, tree])[]
            if not old.has(path)
                added += 1
            elif not tree.has(path)
                deleted += 1
            elif not agree(old, tree, path)
                modified += 1
        emit("[{if branch == "" then "detached HEAD" else branch} {commit_list[number].id}] {message} ({added} added, {modified} modified, {deleted} deleted)")

    void | error .apply_change(Tree base, Tree theirs, string kind, nat target, string message, nat[] parents, nat common := 0)
        Tree current := head_tree()
        result := merge_trees(base, current, theirs)
        selected := differing(current, result.tree)
        try check_overwrite(selected.concat(result.conflicts))
        if kind == "merge"
            emit("Merge base {commit_list[common].id}")
        elif #result.conflicts == 0 and equal_trees(result.tree, current)
            emit("nothing to commit")
            return
        for path := selected[]
            .index.copy_path(result.tree, path)
            .work.copy_path(result.tree, path)
        if #result.conflicts == 0
            .record(parents, result.tree, message)
            return
        for path := result.conflicts[]
            ours := if current.has(path) then current.text(path) else "(deleted)"
            other := if theirs.has(path) then theirs.text(path) else "(deleted)"
            .work.put(path, "<<<<<<< {ours} ======= {other} >>>>>>>")
            emit("CONFLICT {path}")
        conflicts = result.conflicts
        op_kind = kind
        op_target = target
        emit(if kind == "merge" then "Automatic merge failed; fix conflicts and then commit the result." else (if kind == "revert" then "error: could not revert {commit_list[target].id}" else "error: could not apply {commit_list[target].id}"))
        return void

    void show_status()
        nat number := head()
        Tree current := head_tree()
        emit(if branch == "" then "HEAD detached at {commit_list[number].id}" else "On branch {branch}")
        if op_kind != ""
            title := if op_kind == "merge" then "Merging" else (if op_kind == "revert" then "Reverting" else "Cherry-picking")
            emit("{title} {commit_list[op_target].id}")
        string[] lines := []
        for path := unique_words(all_paths([current, index, work]).concat(conflicts))[]
            if member(conflicts, path)
                lines = lines.append("UU {path}")
            elif index.has(path)
                x := if not current.has(path) then "A" else (if not agree(current, index, path) then "M" else ".")
                y := if not work.has(path) then "D" else (if not agree(work, index, path) then "M" else ".")
                if x != "." or y != "."
                    lines = lines.append("{x}{y} {path}")
            else
                if current.has(path)
                    lines = lines.append("D. {path}")
                if work.has(path) and not ignored(path)
                    lines = lines.append("?? {path}")
        emit_lines(if #lines == 0 then ["nothing to commit, working tree clean"] else lines)

    void | error .execute(string line)
        space := find_at(line, " ")
        command := line[:<space]
        argument := if space < #line then line[space + 1:] else ""
        string[] args := if argument == "" then [] else argument.split(" ")
        if command == "COMMIT" or command == "AMEND"
            args = [argument]
        elif command == "WRITE"
            split := find_at(argument, " ")
            args = [argument[:<split], argument[split + 1:]]
        nat h := head()
        Tree current := head_tree()
        if command == "WRITE"
            .work.put(args[0], args[1])
        elif command == "REMOVE"
            if not work.has(args[0])
                return error("no such file '{args[0]}'")
            .work.erase(args[0])
        elif command == "IGNORE"
            ignores = ignores.append(args[0])
        elif command == "ADD"
            path := args[0]
            if path == "ALL"
                selected := [for item := all_paths([work, index])[] if not ignored(item) then item]
                for item := selected[]
                    .index.copy_path(work, item)
                conflicts = []
            else
                if work.has(path) and ignored(path)
                    return error("path '{path}' is ignored")
                if not work.has(path) and not index.has(path) and not member(conflicts, path)
                    return error("pathspec '{path}' did not match any files")
                .index.copy_path(work, path)
                conflicts = [for item := conflicts[] if item != path then item]
        elif command == "RM"
            path := args[0]
            if not index.has(path)
                return error("pathspec '{path}' did not match any files")
            .index.erase(path)
            .work.erase(path)
            conflicts = [for item := conflicts[] if item != path then item]
        elif command == "UNSTAGE"
            path := args[0]
            if not index.has(path) and not current.has(path)
                return error("pathspec '{path}' did not match any files")
            .index.copy_path(current, path)
        elif command == "RESTORE" or command == "CAT"
            path := args[0]
            Tree tree := if command == "RESTORE" then index else work
            if #args == 2
                nat target := try resolve_rev(args[1])
                tree = commit_list[target].tree
            if not tree.has(path)
                return error(if #args == 2 then "path '{path}' does not exist in '{args[1]}'" else (if command == "CAT" then "no such file '{path}'" else "pathspec '{path}' did not match any files"))
            if command == "CAT"
                emit(tree.text(path))
            else
                .work.put(path, tree.text(path))
                if #args == 2
                    .index.put(path, tree.text(path))
                    conflicts = [for item := conflicts[] if item != path then item]
        elif command == "COMMIT"
            if #conflicts > 0
                return error("unresolved conflicts")
            if op_kind == "merge"
                .record([h, op_target], index, args[0])
                op_kind = ""
            elif equal_trees(index, current)
                emit("nothing to commit")
            else
                .record([h], index, args[0])
                op_kind = ""
        elif command == "AMEND"
            try check_progress()
            if #commit_list[h].parents == 0
                return error("cannot amend the root commit")
            .record(commit_list[h].parents, index, args[0])
        elif command == "STATUS"
            show_status()
        elif command == "LS"
            Tree tree := work
            if #args > 0
                nat target := try resolve_rev(args[0])
                tree = commit_list[target].tree
            if tree.data.size() == 0
                emit("(empty)")
            for path := tree.data.keys().sorted()[]
                emit("{path} {tree.text(path)}")
        elif command == "DIFF"
            Tree old := index
            new := Tree()
            if #args == 0
                for path := index.data.keys()[]
                    .new.copy_path(work, path)
            elif args[0] == "STAGED"
                old = current
                new = index
            else
                nat first := try resolve_rev(args[0])
                nat second := try resolve_rev(args[1])
                old = commit_list[first].tree
                new = commit_list[second].tree
            emit_lines(change_list(old, new))
        elif command == "LOG"
            nat limit := if #args == 0 then #commit_list else nat(args[0])
            number := h
            nat printed := 0
            while true
                emit(summary(number))
                printed += 1
                if #commit_list[number].parents == 0 or printed == limit
                    break
                number = commit_list[number].parents[0]
        elif command == "SHOW"
            nat number := try resolve_rev(if #args == 0 then "HEAD" else args[0])
            parents := [for parent := commit_list[number].parents[] then commit_list[parent].id]
            emit("commit {summary(number)}")
            emit("parents: " + (if #parents == 0 then "none" else parents.join(" ")))
            emit_lines(change_list(parent_tree(number), commit_list[number].tree))
        elif command == "BLAME"
            path := args[0]
            if not current.has(path)
                return error("path '{path}' does not exist in 'HEAD'")
            number := h
            while #commit_list[number].parents > 0
                parent := commit_list[number].parents[0]
                if not commit_list[parent].tree.has(path) or commit_list[parent].tree.text(path) != current.text(path)
                    break
                number = parent
            emit("{commit_list[number].id} ({commit_list[number].message}) {current.text(path)}")
        elif command == "BRANCH" or command == "TAG"
            tag := command == "TAG"
            remove := args[0] == "-d"
            name := args[if remove then 1 else 0]
            bool present := if tag then tags.has(name) else branches.has(name)
            noun := if tag then "tag" else "branch"
            if remove
                if not present
                    return error("no such {noun} '{name}'")
                number := reference(if tag then tags else branches, name)
                if not tag and name == branch
                    return error("cannot delete current branch '{name}'")
                if not tag and not ancestor(number, h)
                    return error("branch '{name}' is not fully merged")
                if tag
                    bool removed := .tags.remove(name)
                else
                    bool removed := .branches.remove(name)
                emit("Deleted {noun} {name} (was {commit_list[number].id})")
            else
                if present
                    return error("{noun} '{name}' already exists")
                nat number := try resolve_rev(if #args == 2 then args[1] else "HEAD")
                if tag
                    .tags.set(name, number)
                else
                    .branches.set(name, number)
                emit("Created {noun} {name} at {commit_list[number].id}")
        elif command == "BRANCHES" or command == "TAGS"
            tag := command == "TAGS"
            if not tag and branch == ""
                emit("* (HEAD detached at {commit_list[h].id})")
            names := if tag then tags.keys().sorted() else branches.keys().sorted()
            if tag and #names == 0
                emit("(no tags)")
            for name := names[]
                number := reference(if tag then tags else branches, name)
                prefix := if tag then "" else (if name == branch then "* " else "  ")
                emit("{prefix}{name} {commit_list[number].id} {commit_list[number].message}")
        elif command == "SWITCH"
            name := args[0]
            if not branches.has(name)
                return error("no such branch '{name}'")
            if branch == name
                emit("Already on '{name}'")
            else
                try check_progress()
                try .switch_tree(commit_list[reference(branches, name)].tree)
                branch = name
                emit("Switched to branch '{name}'")
        elif command == "DETACH"
            nat number := try resolve_rev(args[0])
            try check_progress()
            try .switch_tree(commit_list[number].tree)
            branch = ""
            detached = number
            emit("HEAD is now at {commit_list[number].id} {commit_list[number].message}")
        elif command == "MERGEBASE"
            nat first := try resolve_rev(args[0])
            nat second := try resolve_rev(args[1])
            emit(commit_list[merge_base(first, second)].id)
        elif command == "MERGE"
            nat number := try resolve_rev(args[0])
            try check_progress()
            if ancestor(number, h)
                emit("Already up to date")
            elif ancestor(h, number)
                try .switch_tree(commit_list[number].tree)
                .move_head(number)
                emit("Fast-forward {commit_list[h].id}..{commit_list[number].id}")
            else
                try check_clean()
                nat common := merge_base(h, number)
                try .apply_change(commit_list[common].tree, commit_list[number].tree, "merge", number, "Merge {args[0]}", [h, number], common)
        elif command == "REVERT" or command == "CHERRYPICK"
            nat number := try resolve_rev(args[0])
            try check_progress()
            try check_clean()
            if command == "REVERT"
                try .apply_change(commit_list[number].tree, parent_tree(number), "revert", number, "Revert {DQ}{commit_list[number].message}{DQ}", [h])
            else
                try .apply_change(parent_tree(number), commit_list[number].tree, "cherry-pick", number, commit_list[number].message, [h])
        elif command == "RESET"
            nat number := try resolve_rev(args[1])
            tree := commit_list[number].tree
            if args[0] == "HARD"
                for path := unique_words(all_paths([index, tree]).concat(conflicts))[]
                    .work.copy_path(tree, path)
            if args[0] != "SOFT"
                index = tree
            .move_head(number)
            conflicts = []
            op_kind = ""
            emit("HEAD is now at {commit_list[number].id} {commit_list[number].message}")
        elif command == "REBASE"
            nat upstream := try resolve_rev(args[0])
            try check_progress()
            if ancestor(upstream, h)
                emit("Already up to date")
                return
            try check_clean()
            nat[] replay := []
            number := h
            while not ancestor(number, upstream)
                replay = replay.append(number)
                number = commit_list[number].parents[0]
            tree := commit_list[upstream].tree
            Replay[] plan := []
            for: #replay > i >= 0
                original := commit_list[replay[i]]
                result := merge_trees(parent_tree(replay[i]), tree, original.tree)
                if #result.conflicts > 0
                    return error("could not rebase {original.id}: conflict in '{result.conflicts[0]}'")
                pick := not equal_trees(result.tree, tree)
                plan = plan.append(Replay(replay[i], pick, result.tree))
                if pick
                    tree = result.tree
            try .switch_tree(tree)
            tip := upstream
            for step := plan[]
                original := commit_list[step.original]
                if step.pick
                    nat next := .create([tip], step.tree, original.message)
                    emit("pick {original.id} -> {commit_list[next].id} {original.message}")
                    tip = next
                else
                    emit("skip {original.id} {original.message}")
            .move_head(tip)
            emit("HEAD is now at {commit_list[tip].id} {commit_list[tip].message}")
        elif command == "STASH"
            option := if #args == 0 then "" else args[0]
            if option == "LIST"
                if #stash == 0
                    emit("(no stash entries)")
                for: entry := stash[i]
                    emit("stash@{{{i}}}: {entry.label}")
            elif option == "DROP" or option == "POP"
                if #stash == 0
                    return error("no stash entries")
                entry := stash[0]
                if option == "POP"
                    try check_progress()
                    try check_clean()
                    result := merge_trees(commit_list[entry.base].tree, current, entry.tree)
                    if #result.conflicts > 0
                        return error("stash conflict in '{result.conflicts[0]}'")
                    selected := differing(current, result.tree)
                    try check_overwrite(selected)
                    for path := selected[]
                        .work.copy_path(result.tree, path)
                    stash = stash[1:]
                    emit("Restored stash@{{0}}: {entry.label}")
                    emit_lines(change_list(current, result.tree))
                else
                    stash = stash[1:]
                    emit("Dropped stash@{{0}}: {entry.label}")
            else
                try check_progress()
                if not uncommitted()
                    emit("No local changes to save")
                    return
                tracked := all_paths([index, current])
                saved := Tree()
                for path := tracked[]
                    .saved.copy_path(work, path)
                    .work.copy_path(current, path)
                index = current
                label := "WIP on {if branch == "" then "(no branch)" else branch}: {commit_list[h].id} {commit_list[h].message}"
                first := [StashEntry(label, h, saved)]
                stash = first.concat(stash)
                emit("Saved stash@{{0}}: {label}")
        elif command == "DESCRIBE"
            nat number := try resolve_rev(if #args == 0 then "HEAD" else args[0])
            int[] distance := distances(number)
            best := ""
            length := 0
            for name := tags.keys().sorted()[]
                target := reference(tags, name)
                if distance[target] >= 0 and (best == "" or distance[target] < length)
                    best = name
                    length = distance[target]
            if best == ""
                return error("no tag can describe '{commit_list[number].id}'")
            emit(if length == 0 then best else "{best}-{length}-g{commit_list[number].id}")
        elif command == "GRAPH" or command == "GC"
            roots := [h]
            roots = roots.concat(branches.values()).concat(tags.values())
            if command == "GC"
                for entry := stash[]
                    roots = roots.append(entry.base)
                if op_kind != ""
                    roots = roots.append(op_target)
                bool[] kept := reachable(roots)
                nat removed := 0
                for: i < #alive
                    if alive[i] and not kept[i]
                        alive[i] = false
                        removed += 1
                emit("Removed unreachable commits: {removed}")
            else
                bool[] kept := reachable(roots)
                nat[] lanes := []
                for: #commit_list > number >= 0
                    if not kept[number]
                        continue
                    if not has_number(lanes, number)
                        lanes = lanes.append(number)
                    nat at := 0
                    while lanes[at] != number
                        at += 1
                    string[] symbols := []
                    nat[] next := []
                    for: lane := lanes[i]
                        symbols = symbols.append(if i == at then "*" else (if lane == number then "/" else "|"))
                        if i == at or lane != number
                            next = next.append(lane)
                    emit(symbols.join(" ") + " " + summary(number))
                    lanes = next
                    parents := commit_list[number].parents
                    if #parents == 0
                        lanes = lanes[:<at].concat(lanes[at + 1:])
                    else
                        lanes[at] = parents[0]
                        if #parents == 2 and not has_number(lanes, parents[1])
                            lanes = lanes[:<at + 1].append(parents[1]).concat(lanes[at + 1:])
        return void

repository := Repository()
.repository.initialize()
while true
    string line
    scan(&line)
    if line == "EXIT"
        break
    match .repository.execute(line)
        void
            void
        error problem
            emit("error: {problem.message}")
